spec_match.rationale: Probes navigator.mcpServer — a surface that exists in no spec or Chromium build — and frames WebMCP as a JSON-RPC MCP server endpoint; the spec has no tools/call JSON-RPC exchange in the page, it uses document.modelContext.executeTool().

interactive.rationale: Tool list (click and Enter/Space), generated parameter forms, Invoke, and Clear all work and produce request/response trace entries, but everything is a local mock with random outputs.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index blurb says the page invokes tools from a 'simulated MCP server registry', which is accurate, but it is a generic MCP JSON-RPC demo rather than WebMCP.

edge_cases.rationale: Required parameters are not enforced (Invoke with empty query sends only {limit:5}, isError:false); there is no error/isError path except calc parse errors; and the response is computed from the tool selected at response time (race).

references.rationale: No ChromeStatus link, spec link, or references section anywhere on the page (invariant #3).

conformance.rationale: Feature suite (6 assertions) reports 6/6 PASS on CfT 153 both with and without --enable-experimental-web-platform-features; without the flag every assertion passes vacuously (guards like !('modelContext' in document)||…), and registertool-rejects-tool-without-name passes only because reading registerTool off undefined throws TypeError — a false pass that needs a human to review (suite is immutable). The suite targets document.modelContext while this page probes navigator.modelContext.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 driven by Node Playwright (chromium.launch) against a local server on :3111 — NOT chrome-devtools-mcp, which is unavailable in this environment, so this is not DevTools-MCP-verified evidence; no accessibility-tree dump was taken. Bugs reproduced: (1) the placeholder trace line is never removed (selector pre[style*="555"] never matches); (2) invoking search_documents then clicking get_weather inside the 300–700ms delay returns a get_weather result under request id 2; (3) location '' executes (window.__xss===1) via highlightJSON→innerHTML. Badge says navigator.mcpServer unavailable, with and without the flag.

telemetry_health.rationale: Only shared runtime/console capture; it recorded the 'Invalid or unexpected token' pageerror from the injected handler.

design_system.rationale: Variables and paired button colours; readable in screenshot.

accessibility.rationale: Tool rows are role=button with tabindex and key handlers, but parameter <label>s are not associated (no for=), the selected tool has no aria-pressed/selected, and the trace has no live region.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px overflow both classes; one control under 44px on mobile.

openQuestions.title: Remove the fictional navigator.mcpServer probe and reframe on document.modelContext
openQuestions.detail: navigator.mcpServer does not exist; the real flagged surface on CfT 153 is document.modelContext (registerTool/getTools/executeTool). Register the four tools there when present, call executeTool(tool, JSON.stringify(args)), and label the JSON-RPC panel as an MCP-protocol analogy, not WebMCP wire format. Give exact flag steps (chrome://flags/#enable-experimental-web-platform-features).

openQuestions.title: Escape trace JSON before syntax highlighting
openQuestions.detail: Repro: select get_weather, location = , Invoke → window.__xss===1. highlightJSON regex-wraps JSON.stringify output and assigns innerHTML; escape &<> first or build spans with textContent.

openQuestions.title: Bind the response to the tool that was invoked
openQuestions.detail: Repro: Invoke search_documents, immediately click get_weather → response id 2 contains weather data. Capture const tool = selectedTool before setTimeout.

openQuestions.title: Add the ChromeStatus/spec references section
openQuestions.detail: Page has no chromestatus.com/feature/5117755740913664 link (self-heal invariant #3) and no spec link.

openQuestions.title: Fix placeholder removal, enforce required params, associate labels
openQuestions.detail: Placeholder selector pre[style*="555"] never matches the var(--text-muted) placeholder; required inputs (*) should block or return an isError result; add for= to generated labels.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Never interpolate user-controlled strings into innerHTML; use textContent or DOM construction.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Not followed — user input reaches innerHTML via highlightJSON (confirmed execution).

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous/changing results through a polite live region (role=status/log or aria-live) and keep controls as native buttons with accessible names.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Not followed — trace has no live region.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic/grid layouts that collapse to one column at narrow widths (minmax(0,1fr), container/media queries) so no fixed-column track forces horizontal overflow.

summary: A generic MCP JSON-RPC playground mislabelled as WebMCP, probing a non-existent navigator.mcpServer, with no ChromeStatus link and three reproducible bugs: an XSS sink, a stale-selection race, and a placeholder that never clears.
